summary: {person} finds the airport kiosk's late-opening fine taken out of pay.
realLife: A kiosk worker complained to Denver that an employer was passing airport penalties for late openings on to employees.
gates: A deduction corresponds to a charge assessed against the business.
weights: Matching dates tie a deduction to a particular opening.
inGame: needs: the business fine, payroll deduction and dates.

turns.pulledBy: The payroll record shows no deduction.
turns.writesBack: The charge stays in the company's accounts.

turns.what: Only one deduction matches a fine.
turns.writesBack: The claim lists each deduction separately.
